data.title: bn-5txc: fix O(n^2) semantic manifest validation (list->set membership)
data.description: evidence_schema.py _validate_recursive_semantic_manifest: replace 'relative in paths' (O(N) list membership, quadratic over 225k-entry cargo-home manifests) with a set-backed 'relative in seen'; keep the ordered paths list for the insertion-order check at line ~3639. Semantics identical (duplicate paths still rejected). Empirically: real 225,566-entry manifest validates in 1.7s vs unfinished at 2h48m. Self-tests: runner 163/163, verifier 187/187, evaluator pending. Commit 79ca5bf.
